title: Elux Legend Juicy Peach Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend's Juicy Peach Nic Salt delivers the rich, sunny flavour of ripe Peach in every puff. Bursting with natural sweetness and a soft, velvety finish, this e-liquid is perfect for vapers who enjoy smooth and simple fruity profiles. Elux Legend Nic Salts are double-concentrated to replicate the bold and intense flavours of Elux’s bestselling disposable vapes. Crafted with a smooth nicotine salt formula, these e-liquids provide near-instant nicotine relief with minimal throat irritation, offering a satisfying and flavourful vape. Mixed with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Juicy Peach Nic Salt is ideal for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and refillable pod systems. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, this e-liquid offers a versatile and refreshing vaping experience for adult smokers and vapers.
